title: UoC-Assistant
description: A full-stack student planner built with React, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, FastAPI, and Python that generates custom semester plans based on work hours and goals, using Python checks to enforce prerequisites and prevent exam overlaps. Includes a Gemini API RAG chatbot over academic PDFs with exact source citations.

title: GameHub
description: A video game discovery app that helps you find new and interesting games to play.

title: RecipeSharing Platform
description: A web app for sharing and discovering recipes based on dietary preferences, cuisine, and available ingredients.

title: Unity Runner Game
description: A fast-paced runner game developed using Unity and deployed as a WebGL application. Navigate through obstacles, collect power-ups, and achieve high scores!
